zh-CN.title: 孔子（孔丘）
zh-CN.subtitle: 经典教育、礼与政治伦理的历史人物
zh-CN.shortSummary: 孔子是儒家经典、教育和政治伦理的高识别度入口；《论语》中的孔子言说必须和弟子记录、编纂层及后世经学接受分开。
curatorialDescription: 孔子的历史人物层可以与《史记·孔子世家》、周礼问学叙事和教学活动相连，但《论语》不是脱离传述历史的单一作者文本。
从孔子到孔颖达，博物馆呈现的是‘人物—言说—编纂—制度接受’的长链，而不是把唐代经学倒推成孔子本人直接参与。
zh-CN.researchNote: 孔子生平有早期史传依据；《论语》为复合性传述文本，具体言说关系以 recorded_by_others 标注，唐代制度接受另行连接。

value.zh-CN: 孔子言说经由弟子与编纂传统保存
value.en: Confucius's sayings survive through disciples and compilation traditions

en.title: Confucius (Kong Qiu)
en.subtitle: A historical figure of classical education, ritual and political ethics
en.shortSummary: Confucius is a recognisable gateway into Confucian classics, education and political ethics; sayings in the Analects must be separated from disciple records, compilation layers and later classical reception.
curatorialDescription: The historical-person layer can connect Confucius with the House of Confucius in the Shiji, the Zhou rites-asking narrative and teaching activity, while the Analects remains a composite text of transmitted sayings.

From Confucius to Kong Yingda, the museum presents a long chain of person, speech, compilation and institutional reception rather than projecting Tang classical learning back onto Confucius as direct participation.
en.researchNote: Confucius has an early historiographical record. The Analects is a composite transmitted text; saying relations are marked recorded_by_others, while Tang institutional reception is modelled separately.
